title: Import goods from a document
description: Upload an image or a PDF of an invoice with the bought drinks. Only the names and quantities are read, and you check everything before it is added to the stock.
hint: PDF, JPG or PNG up to 10 MB. On a phone you can take a photo of the document directly.
